source.source_oracle: pinned node, shader, shader-function helpers, and palette/random constructors

physical_controls.native_requirement: an observed seed is required when Active is true; do not invent a fixed fallback

physical_controls.default: copy of PROJ_PALETTE at source node construction; native unlinked/default resolution uses current durable project palette, while authored or linked palettes win

replace_chance_mapped.numeric_profile: Finite numeric toggles use native nonzero truth; licensed runner coercion is unverified.

palette_contract.source_constructor: nodeValue_Palette copies the current PROJ_PALETTE when the node is constructed; this is dynamic, not a universal white/black default.
palette_contract.catalogue_capture: The pinned catalogue capture shows white and black, but that capture is not a universal default project palette.
palette_contract.native_default_resolution: For an unlinked catalogue-default palette, use the current durable document/project palette. Explicit or linked palette values take precedence. This is a native current-project policy; historical constructor-time palette state is not observable and parity is not claimed.
palette_contract.supported_shape: Accept explicit flat depth-1 palettes, depth-2 palettes with processor-row axis selection, and singleton Color getter values.
palette_contract.empty_palette: Unsupported because an empty ambient shader uniform cannot be resolved deterministically.
palette_contract.over_limit: Palettes larger than the 256-entry shader array are refused rather than truncated.

color_conversion.source_helper: colToVec4 distinguishes int64 packed colors (including packed alpha) from real colors (uses supplied/default alpha, normally 1).
color_conversion.pxcx_import: PxcxImport PackedColour accepts finite integral JSON numbers in [0,UINT32_MAX], decodes low-byte R then G, B, high-byte A, and erases whether the JSON number was originally integer or real.
color_conversion.native_imported_profile: Imported palette values follow the decoded packed-RGBA channels; this does not claim source numeric-token parity for int64-versus-real inputs.

palette_contract.animation: Source palette interpolation resamples flat colours with merge_color. Nested between-key colour arithmetic and palette driver arithmetic are unverified and explicitly unsupported. Undriven raw first-at-time-zero and final keys remain supported; saved key arrays are preserved.

active_contract.accepted_values: Typed booleans, or finite numeric values interpreted true only when greater than 0.5.

inactive_behavior.direct_inactive: Direct inactive copy charges 16 estimated work units per output pixel and preserves the copied image format.
inactive_behavior.whole_tree_inactive: Prebatch inactive path clones the complete source ImageArray once, preserving shape, order, and formats; it uses existing global tree-clone work/byte bounds, not the active kernel 64M cap.
inactive_behavior.effects: Both inactive paths skip seed handling and effect-control arrays.

active_contract.numeric_backend: This is a named native profile. Licensed runner numeric coercion behavior is unresolved; no parity claim is made.
active_contract.image_pool: Clone tree leaves by value in traversal order. Repeated image references become separate copied leaves; logical shape and pixels are preserved.

seed_and_randomness.source_seed_constructor: seed_random(6) initializes the source node seed at construction; no fixed seed is declared by the source.
seed_and_randomness.native_missing_seed: Refuse active processing when no observed numeric seed is available; never supply an invented fixed fallback.
seed_and_randomness.frame_seed: Add the raw numeric authored/runtime seed to CURRENT_FRAME in double precision, then cast the sum to shader float. Do not add a local clock or processor-row offset.
seed_and_randomness.shader_hash: random(v_vTexcoord, seed) adds mod(seed,100000)/10 to UV coordinates, dots with (853.98598,78.2345543), then applies fract(sin(dot)*47.687523).
seed_and_randomness.negative_values: Preserve GLSL floor-based mod/fract behavior for negative floating values in the hash profile.

pixel_contract.active_output: RGBA8 fixed output for active processing.
pixel_contract.base_sampling: Plain source draw path uses a bounded native nearest-sampling profile. A one-channel R source is sampled as raw R=(r,0,0,1), not through the grayscale channel helper. GPU/filter backend parity is unverified.
pixel_contract.map_sampling: Nearest sample at the output UV; compute raw mean of RGB only, ignoring map alpha. For an R-only sample profile (r,0,0,1), the mean is r/3.
pixel_contract.chance_mapping: Honor replace_chance_mapped and the synthetic replace_chance_map_range when enabled. PXC persistence retains the synthetic range, allows a missing stored physical Replace Chance when reconstructed by mapping state, and preserves linked raw Replace Chance precedence.
pixel_contract.replacement: Compare the original source RGB distance to palette RGB in order. On the first distance <= Threshold, replace the whole RGBA value with the next palette entry and stop. No chaining and no wrap from the final entry.
pixel_contract.channels: Threshold and Replace Chance are passed as raw numeric controls; do not clamp them unless source/widget rules explicitly require it.
pixel_contract.output: Write the selected/replaced source color to the fixed RGBA8 output.

admission.active_work_units: Cumulative estimated units for all selected active processor rows.
admission.active_preflight: Quote work, bytes, palette data, and finite controls for every selected row before allocation or publication.
admission.whole_tree_inactive: Uses existing global tree-clone bounds, not the active kernel cap.
admission.finite_controls: Reject nonfinite or out-of-range values before float conversion or shader-equation evaluation.
